name: Chaos Breed, Lesser
body:
School transmutation [chaotic]; Level antipaladin 2, cleric/oracle 2, sorcerer/wizard 2

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range personal
Target self
Duration 1 minute/level (D)
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

You take on an aspect of a being of pure chaos, including some of its physical characteristics. You gain blindsense out to 5 feet, resistance to acid 5, resistance to electricity 5, and the benefits of protection from law.
